answer: Deposit-gated identity: each new agent must lock a slashable bond before it may attest. A key alone is free, so every identity must carry real value at risk. An attacker wanting ten thousand fake peers must fund ten thousand bonds, and a verifier that catches one forged attestation burns them all. Registration is priced like a scarce cut of timber: carve more planks if you like, never for free. Honest agents withdraw their stake on exit, so the meadow stays open to newcomers while a forger's farm rents every blade of grass. The opal is not the point; copying it must cost as much as mining it.
